kinds.a: nightlatch · Yale lock · rim deadlock · rim sashlock
kinds.d: A surface-mounted lock on the inside face of a door, worked by a rim cylinder from outside and a knob or snib inside.

kinds.a: mortise lock · mortice deadlock · mortice sashlock · mortice latch
kinds.d: A lock case sunk into the door edge; a deadlock has a key-thrown bolt only, a sashlock adds a handle-worked latch, a latch has no bolt.

kinds.a: bore-through deadbolt · single-cylinder deadbolt · double-cylinder deadbolt
kinds.d: A North-American bolt lock fitted through a bored hole above the knob, thrown by key or thumb-turn, graded ANSI/BHMA 1–3.

kinds.a: euro cylinder · profile cylinder · rim cylinder · barrel · key cylinder
kinds.d: The key-operated barrel sold apart from the lock case; chosen by profile and by anti-snap, drill and bump rating.

kinds.a: entry knob · entry lever · handleset · door handle lockset
kinds.d: A knob or lever set with its own key cylinder fitted through the door, often paired with a deadbolt in a handleset.

kinds.a: connected lock · app lock · keyless smart deadbolt
kinds.d: An electromechanical door lock opened by phone, keypad, fingerprint or home-automation hub, as a retrofit module or a full replacement.

kinds.a: push-button lock · digital door lock · code lock · mechanical combination door lock
kinds.d: A door lock opened by a code on mechanical push buttons or an electronic keypad, with no app needed.

kinds.a: sliding door lock · French door bolt · patio bolt
kinds.d: An add-on lock or bolt for a sliding or French patio door, fitted to the frame or the meeting stiles.
m: In Front Patio Door Foot Pedal

kinds.a: gate lock · bullet lock · garage door lock · shutter lock · long-throw lock
kinds.d: A lock made for a garden gate, up-and-over garage door or roller shutter, surface-mounted or set into the profile.

kinds.a: cam lock · drawer lock · locker lock · mailbox lock
kinds.d: A small keyed lock for a cupboard, drawer, locker or mailbox, turning a cam or small bolt.

brands.d: Lock maker founded by Linus Yale Jr. and Henry Towne, now Assa Abloy outside North America and Fortune Brands in the US and Canada.
American lock maker founded by Walter Schlage, owned by Allegion; one of the most popular US consumer lock brands.
American lock and lockset maker that pioneered the tubular lock; known for the KW1 keyway and SmartKey re-keying.
Family-owned Wetter firm (August Bremicker und Söhne) making padlocks, door cylinders, bicycle locks, alarms and cameras.
San Francisco smart-lock company founded by Yves Béhar and Jason Johnson, bought by Assa Abloy in 2017.
British lock brand of Assa Abloy with over 180 years' history; took over the former Chubb mortice ranges.
Willenhall lock maker started by John Reynolds in 1838, making mortice locks, patio locks and window hardware.
UK architectural-hardware brand whose Easi-T mortice locks and contract euro cylinders are widely sold through builders' merchants.
Austrian maker of retrofit smart locks fitted over the inside of a euro-cylinder door; current Smart Lock Pro supports Matter over Thread.
Level Home makes compact smart locks that hide inside a standard deadbolt, with Apple Home Key and Matter-over-Thread.
Smart-home brand whose U100 deadbolt lock offers fingerprint entry and Apple Home Key.
U-tec's smart-lock brand known for the U-Bolt Pro multi-way (fingerprint, keypad, app, key) deadbolt.
Swiss security group formed from Kaba and Dorma; its Simplex mechanical push-button locks define the keypad door lock.
LockeyUSA makes mechanical keyless digital-combination lever and knob locks with lifetime mechanical warranty.
UK maker of mechanical push-button and electronic code locks for doors and cabinets.
UK brand of mechanical digital coded door locks sold in BL-numbered series.

notes: Shelf 'Door locks' rebuilt as 10 tier kinds from 13 old kinds: Night latch + Rim lock merged; Mortice deadlock/sashlock/latch merged with types; Euro cylinder + Rim cylinder merged into Lock cylinder with profile types; Gate lock + Shutter/garage lock merged; Smart lock and Keypad door lock added (sourced from Wikipedia Smart lock and dormakaba Simplex 1000). Models cut to market-covering brands plus Consumer Reports winners (Kwikset Juno 991J15SMTCP best standard lock; Yale Assure Lock 2 best Wi-Fi; August Wi-Fi Smart Lock best retrofit; Eufy S230, Level Lock Pro, Ultraloq, Aqara from CR smart-lock list) and UK locksmith-recommended BS 3621 ranges (Union 3G114E/3K74E/2134E, ERA Fortress). Dropped: LPD Manhattan Deadbolt (retailer SKU noise); Schlage B60 and Avocet ABS cylinder (pages not retrievable this session); Nuki/Yale Linus versions beyond current generation (unconfirmed). Multipoint locks, gearboxes and installed intruder hardware are not here (Home Fixtures). High-security restricted-key cylinders (Abloy Protec2, Mul-T-Lock, Medeco, EVVA) belong to the Locksport shelf. No archetypes used (tier shelf); no traditions apply. Eufy, Fuhr, Ingersoll, Tessi, BW Hardware, Atlantic appear only as model makers without register pages.
